description: This file is a Ruby script for redis-trib, a deprecated tool for managing Redis clusters. It includes functions for colorizing output, parsing command-line options, generating command examples, and provides user guidance messages about migrating to redis-cli.

classes.name: String
classes.description: Extended Ruby String class with methods for colorized output.

methods.name: colorized
methods.description: Applies terminal color codes to a string based on the specified color.

methods.name: parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for a given command, extracting options and positional arguments.

methods.name: command_example
methods.description: Constructs a redis-cli command string with cluster subcommand, arguments, and options.
